WITH sales AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'TY' END per, s.store_id, f.sale_date, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND ((f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25') OR (f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31'))),
ret AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'TY' END per, s.store_id, r.refund_net
 FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND ((r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25') OR (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31'))),
rpt AS (
 SELECT CASE WHEN business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' THEN 'LY' ELSE 'TY' END per, sum(net_sales_before_returns) g, sum(returns_net) r, sum(net_sales) n, count(DISTINCT business_date) nd, count(DISTINCT store_id) ns
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<900 AND ((business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25') OR (business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31')) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT 'fact_sales' src, per, count(DISTINCT sale_date) nd, count(DISTINCT store_id) ns, sum(net_amount) g, sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE staff_purchase_flag) staff, NULL r FROM sales GROUP BY per
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_ret', per, NULL, count(DISTINCT store_id), NULL, NULL, sum(refund_net) FROM ret GROUP BY per
UNION ALL SELECT 'rpt', per, nd, ns, g, n, r FROM rpt

WITH daily AS (
 SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<900),
lfl AS (SELECT store_id FROM daily WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' GROUP BY 1 INTERSECT SELECT store_id FROM daily WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT
 count(DISTINCT d.store_id) n_stores,
 sum(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25') ly_all,
 sum(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31') ty_all,
 sum(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' AND business_date<>DATE '2025-05-01') ly_adj,
 sum(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' AND business_date<>DATE '2026-05-07') ty_adj,
 sum(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' AND business_date<>DATE '2025-05-01' AND d.store_id NOT IN (136,137)) ly_adj_ex,
 sum(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' AND business_date<>DATE '2026-05-07' AND d.store_id NOT IN (136,137)) ty_adj_ex
FROM daily d JOIN lfl USING (store_id)

calls.statement:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id < 900
),
lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT store_id FROM daily WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' GROUP BY 1
  INTERSECT
  SELECT store_id FROM daily WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' GROUP BY 1
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    sum(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-05-25' AND business_date <> DATE '2025-05-01') AS ly_net_sales,
    sum(net_sales) FILTER (WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-31' AND business_date <> DATE '2026-05-07') AS ty_net_sales
  FROM daily JOIN lfl_stores USING (store_id)
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, round((ty_net_sales / ly_net_sales - 1) * 100, 2) AS lfl_growth_pct FROM agg
